review:
The Bonanza engine at a medieval fair: pay-anywhere wins and scatters that can land on any reel.

What's new is the free spins progress bar. Rounds come in 10, 20 or 30 spins, you start with 2x–5x multipliers, and as the bar fills, bigger ones unlock – right up to 100x – and start landing at random. It gives the bonus a proper build-up the original Bonanza Billion doesn't have. High volatility, a 14,134x max and 96% RTP. Free spins about once every 332 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 332 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
